# Exercises for shared-state.
#
# Each fixture holds state that two things touch: two workers on one row, a broker
# that delivers a message again after a restart, a lease timed by the clock. The
# skill says the write carries what the read saw, a handler survives a second
# delivery, and a concurrency fix ships with a test that fails without it. The
# verifiers force the interleaving, restart the process, and run the agent's tests
# against the unfixed code.

# Read, check, write with no version. A lock in one worker's memory does nothing for
# a second process, and a fix with no test that fails on the old reserve is unproven.
[lost-update] two checkout workers sometimes both reserve the last unit of a product, fix inventory.reserve | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# The broker delivers at least once. A set of seen ids in memory is gone after the
# restart that causes the redelivery, and two payments can share an account and amount.
[duplicate-delivery] after the consumer restarts the broker redelivers messages and customers get credited twice, fix it | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# A lease test that sleeps past the deadline. A longer sleep is slower and still races
# the runner; a test that stops checking expiry passes on a lease that never expires.
[sleep-test] test_lease.py is slow and fails on the CI runners now and then, fix it | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

[lost-response] customers are charged twice when the payment gateway times out during the nightly billing run, fix billing so a timeout cannot double charge and a flaky gateway still gets invoices through | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

[skewed-merge] settings changed on one device sometimes get overwritten by an older value from another device after a sync, fix replica so the latest change wins on every device | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

[out-of-order] the warehouse mirror sometimes shows an order with an older status than the orders service, fix on_order_updated so the mirror ends up matching the service | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
